name: tweener
description: Tweener is a multi-sport rating platform for tennis, padel, pickleball and beach tennis. Connect your account and ask Claude about your own game — your schedule, match history, ratings and rating history, head-to-heads against an opponent, ranking standings, match notes, your AI coaching plan, opponent scouting reports and workout stats — find open plays near you or create one, set up auto-match so Tweener suggests partners, and save a note about a match or an opponent.
